milestone.title: Cut 0.7.0rc2 on cross-provider, platform and recovery evidence
milestone.outcome: Release-candidate evidence is complete: capability evidence is total over the declared set, cross-provider conformance holds on the two certified runtimes, platforms are certified on real hosts, upgrade from 0.6.x and rollback are rehearsed, partial publication recovers, headless operation and the first-user journey pass, and the 25 console journeys replay live on a migrated tree; 0.7.0rc2 is published.
exclusions: new product behaviour, which rc1 ships
the perfect-realization gate, which stable runs

acceptance_journey.action: review the committed release-candidate evidence set
acceptance_journey.expected_observation: every rc2 evidence row is present and bound to its certification record
the pre-flight passes and 0.7.0rc2 is tagged and observed
